investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence was introduced to tackle organised begging by making it unlawful, for example, for persons to operate organised begging gangs or to drive individuals to places for them to beg.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment. In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the ‘maximum term for summary offences’ reference is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment, for offences committed after that section comes into force, the reference is to be read as 51 weeks imprisonment. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
